questions.question: A particle moves along the x-axis such that its velocity is given by v = 2x^2 + x (in m/s, where x is in meters). The acceleration of the particle at x = 2 m is:

A block of mass 4 kg is placed on a rough horizontal plane with coefficient of static friction 0.4. A force F = 10t N (where t is time in seconds) is applied horizontally. The time at which the block just starts to slide is (g = 10 m/s^2):

The compound rod is subjected to equal and opposite pulls of magnitude 5 x 10^4 N at its ends. If the elongations of the two rods are equal, then the length L of the steel rod is (Y_brass = 10^11 N/m^2, Y_steel = 2 x 10^11 N/m^2):
